Experience O'ahu on a 99.9% customizable Waikiki: Personal and Custom Tour. This tour lets you customize and explore iconic landmarks and majestic beaches with breathtaking views from Diamond Head to the North Shore and anywhere in between, at your own pace.

Custom Itinerary Options:
